name: jaikhyapaparampara
description: Jai Khyapa Parampara - Spiritual website with 11ty blog

scripts.clean: node -e "require('fs').rmSync('_site', { recursive: true, force: true, maxRetries: 10, retryDelay: 200 })"
scripts.sync-readme-count: node scripts/update_readme_article_count.js || python scripts/update_readme_article_count.py || python3 scripts/update_readme_article_count.py
scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run sync-readme-count && npm run analytics:fetch && eleventy && node scripts/update_build.js _site/index.html
scripts.build:test: npm run clean && npm run analytics:fetch && eleventy
scripts.serve: npm run clean && npm run sync-readme-count && eleventy --serve
scripts.start: npm run clean && npm run sync-readme-count && eleventy --serve

author: KaliPutra-Ashish
